# Tempo Explorer — Full LLM Reference

> Comprehensive reference for agents and AI systems using Tempo Explorer.

Tempo Explorer is a blockchain explorer for the Tempo network. It helps users inspect blocks, transactions, receipts, addresses, contracts, tokens, TIP-403 policies, balances, Fee AMM pools, and on-chain events.

For a shorter overview, see [`/llms.txt`](/llms.txt).

## Networks

Each network has its own deployment. Routes and parameters are the same on every network.

| Network | URL | Redirects from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| testnet | https://explore.testnet.tempo.xyz | explore.42431.tempo.xyz, explore.moderato.tempo.xyz |
| devnet | https://explore.31318.tempo.xyz, https://explore.devnet.tempo.xyz | - |
| zone-prover | https://explore.zone-prover.devnet.tempo.xyz | - |
| nextfork | https://explore.nextfork.devnet.tempo.xyz | - |
| mainnet | https://explore.tempo.xyz | explore.4217.tempo.xyz, explore.mainnet.tempo.xyz, explore.presto.tempo.xyz |

## Page Routes

### Home

- `/`

Search for an address, transaction hash, block number, or token symbol, name, or address. Results are grouped by blocks, addresses, tokens, and transactions.

Query parameters:

- `q` (string): Prefills the search input.

### Search redirect

- `/search`

Redirects to the matching block, address, receipt, or unique token for `q`, or back to the home search when there is no single match.

Query parameters:

- `q` (string): Address, transaction hash, block number, or token query.

### Address

- `/address/{address}`

Shows an account, contract, or TIP-20 token: type, balances, activity, and creation or last-activity metadata. Transactions and balances can be exported as CSV. The tabs shown depend on the address type.

Query parameters:

- `tab`: Address view. Defaults to `token` for TIP-20 tokens and `transactions` otherwise.
  - `transactions`: Transaction history.
  - `transfers`: Token transfers. For a token, every transfer of that token.
  - `holdings`: Current token balances.
  - `fees`: Unclaimed validator fees, when the address has any.
  - `holders`: Holders of the token, when the address is a token.
  - `token`: TIP-20 token metadata and configuration.
  - `contract`: Contract source, ABI, and bytecode, when available.
  - `interact`: Read and write contract functions, when an ABI is available.
  - `deposits`: Zone portal deposits.
  - `withdrawals`: Zone portal withdrawals.
  - `batches`: Zone portal batches.
- `status` (`reverted` | `success`): Filter transactions by status.
- `period` (`24h` | `7d`): Filter transactions to the last 24 hours or 7 days.
- `dir` (`received` | `sent`): Filter transactions sent or received by the address.
- `a` (string): Filter a token’s transfers to one account address.
- `transferDirection` (`in` | `out`): With `a`, filter transfers into or out of that account.
- `hideSubmitBatches` (boolean): Hide zone batch submissions from transactions.
- `page` (number, default `1`): Page number.
- `limit` (number, default `10`): Rows per page.

### Token redirect

- `/token/{address}`

Redirects to `/address/{address}`. Without `tab`, TIP-20 tokens open on `tab=token`; links with `a`, and other tokens, open on `tab=transfers`. `holders`, `token`, and `contract` are kept, and `interact` opens `contract`.

Query parameters:

- `tab` (string): Address tab to open.
- `a` (string): Account filter, passed through.
- `page` (number): Page number.
- `limit` (number): Rows per page.

### Transaction

- `/tx/{hash}`

Shows transaction details.

Query parameters:

- `tab` (default `overview`): Transaction view.
  - `overview`: Receipt and transaction summary.
  - `balances`: Balance changes.
  - `calls`: Decoded calls, when available.
  - `events`: Raw and decoded logs.
  - `trace`: Call trace and prestate diff, when available.
  - `raw`: Raw transaction and receipt JSON.
- `page` (number, default `1`): Page number for paginated tabs.

### Receipt

- `/receipt/{hash}`

The canonical receipt view of what a transaction did. Append `.json`, `.txt`, or `.pdf` to the hash, or send a matching `Accept` header, for a machine-readable export; `curl` and `wget` receive plain text.

### Blocks

- `/blocks`

Recent blocks with number, hash, time, and transaction count. Follows the chain head live unless `from` is set.

Query parameters:

- `from` (number): Start the list at this block number.
- `live` (boolean): Follow new blocks (`true`) or pause the list (`false`).

### Block

- `/block/{id}`

`id` is a block number, block hash, or `latest`. Shows hash, number, timestamp, gas usage, proposer, parent hash, and the block’s transactions.

Query parameters:

- `page` (number, default `1`): Page of the block’s transactions.

### Block countdown

- `/block/countdown/{targetBlock}`

Estimated time until a future block number.

### Tokens

- `/tokens`

Discovered TIP-20 tokens with symbol, name, currency, holders, address, and creation time.

Query parameters:

- `page` (number): Page number.

### Fee AMM

- `/fee-amm`

Fee AMM pools discovered from mint activity: pool pair, reserves, liquidity, creation and latest mint time, and mint count. Each pool pairs a fee token with a validator token.

Query parameters:

- `token` (hex): Show only pools that include this token address.
- `page` (number, default `1`): Page number.
- `limit` (`10` | `25` | `50`, default `10`): Rows per page.

### TIP-403 policy

- `/policy/{id}`

A TIP-403 transfer policy: type, administrator, members, composed policies, and policy events.

Query parameters:

- `q` (string): Search members by address.
- `page` (number, default `1`): Page of members.
- `limit` (number, default `10`): Members per page.

### Simulate

- `/simulate`

Simulate a call or batch against the chain and inspect the result, trace, state changes, events, and gas. Inputs are kept in the URL, so links reproduce the simulation, except calldata or batches too large for a URL.

Query parameters:

- `from` (hex, default `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`): Sender address.
- `to` (hex): Target contract address.
- `data` (hex, default `0x`): Calldata.
- `value` (string, default `0`): Value in base units.
- `gas` (string, default `50000000`): Gas limit.
- `block` (hex | `latest`, default `latest`): Block to simulate against.
- `tx` (hex): Load the inputs of an existing transaction.
- `calls` (string[][]): Additional batch calls as `[[to, data, value], ...]`.
- `tab` (`events` | `gas` | `overview` | `state` | `trace`, default `overview`): Result view.
- `step` (number): Narrow results to one call of a batch, by index.

## Public API Routes

API routes return JSON unless noted. Parameters marked required are rejected when missing.

### Search

- `GET /api/search`

Searches blocks, addresses, transactions, and tokens. Returns `{ results, query }`, where each result has a `type` of `block`, `address`, `token`, or `transaction`. Use it when the input type is unknown.

Query parameters:

- `q` (string, required): Search query. Without it the response has no results.

### Address metadata

- `GET /api/address/metadata/{address}`

Account type, transaction and holder counts, and creation and last-activity details.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

### Address balances

- `GET /api/address/balances/{address}`

Token balances held by the address.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

### Address history

- `GET /api/address/history/{address}`

Paginated transaction history with decoded activity.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

Query parameters:

- `limit` (number): Maximum transactions to return.
- `sort` (`asc` | `desc`, default `desc`): Sort order by block.
- `cursor` (string): Cursor from the previous response.
- `include` (`all` | `received` | `sent`, default `all`): Transactions sent, received, or both.
- `status` (`reverted` | `success`): Filter by transaction status.
- `after` (number): Only transactions after this Unix timestamp, in seconds.
- `hideSubmitBatches` (`false` | `true`): Hide zone batch submissions.

### Address live feed

- `GET /api/address/live/{address}`

Server-sent events stream of new activity for the address.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

Query parameters:

- `kind` (`account-transfers` | `token-transfers` | `transactions`, required): Activity to stream.
- `limit` (number, default `10`): Maximum initial rows.
- `account` (hex): With `kind=token-transfers`, only transfers of this account.
- `direction` (`in` | `out`): Transfers into or out of the account.
- `include` (`all` | `received` | `sent`, default `all`): Transactions sent, received, or both.
- `status` (`reverted` | `success`): Filter by transaction status.
- `after` (number): Only activity after this Unix timestamp, in seconds.
- `hideSubmitBatches` (`false` | `true`): Hide zone batch submissions.

### Zone portal overview

- `GET /api/address/zone-portal/{address}`

Summary of a zone portal contract.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

### Zone portal activity

- `GET /api/address/zone-portal/{address}/{kind}`

Paginated zone portal deposits, withdrawals, or batches.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)
- `kind` (`batches` | `deposits` | `withdrawals`)

Query parameters:

- `page` (number, default `1`): Page number.
- `limit` (number, default `10`): Rows per page.

### Contract creation

- `GET /api/contract/creation/{address}`

Creation transaction and block for a contract.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

### Contract source

- `GET /api/code`

Verified contract source and ABI.

Query parameters:

- `chainid` (number, required): Chain ID.
- `address` (hex, required): Contract address.
- `highlight` (boolean): Include syntax-highlighted source.

### ABI lookup

- `POST /api/abi/batch`

Resolves ABIs for contract addresses and signatures for 4-byte selectors in one request.

JSON body:

- `addresses` (string[], required): Contract addresses.
- `selectors` (string[], required): Function or event selectors.

### Transaction balance changes

- `GET /api/tx/balance-changes/{hash}`

Token balance changes caused by the transaction.

Path parameters:

- `hash` (hex)

Query parameters:

- `limit` (number): Maximum changes to return.
- `offset` (number): Changes to skip.

### Transaction trace

- `GET /api/tx/trace/{hash}`

Call trace and prestate diff.

Path parameters:

- `hash` (hex)

### Simulate

- `POST /api/simulate`

Simulates a call or batch. Returns the result, or a single `panel` when one is requested.

JSON body:

- `chainId` (`4217` | `31318` | `31319` | `42431`, required): Chain ID of the explorer host’s network; other networks are rejected.
- `from` (hex, required): Sender address.
- `to` (hex, required): Target address.
- `data` (hex, required): Calldata.
- `value` (string, default `0`): Value in base units.
- `gas` (string, required): Gas limit.
- `block` (hex | `latest`, default `latest`): Block to simulate against.
- `panel` (`execution` | `prestate` | `trace`): Return only this part of the result.
- `calls` (object[]): The whole ordered batch as `{ to, data, value }` objects. When set, it replaces the top-level `to`, `data`, and `value`, which are still required.

### TIP-20 roles

- `GET /api/tip20-roles`

Role holders and configuration of a TIP-20 token.

Query parameters:

- `address` (hex, required): Token address.
- `chainId` (string): Chain ID. Defaults to the explorer’s chain.

### Verified tokens

- `GET /api/verified-tokens`

Curated verified token addresses for the chain.

### Token logo

- `GET /api/token/logo/{address}`

The token’s curated logo image.

Path parameters:

- `address` (hex)

### JSON-RPC

- `POST /api/rpc`

Proxies JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, single or batched, to the network’s node. Accepts `eth_chainId`, `eth_blockNumber`, `eth_getBlockByNumber`, `eth_getBlockByHash`, `eth_getBlockTransactionCountByNumber`, `eth_getBlockTransactionCountByHash`, `eth_getTransactionByHash`, `eth_getTransactionReceipt`, `eth_getBlockReceipts`, `eth_getTransactionByBlockHashAndIndex`, `eth_getTransactionByBlockNumberAndIndex`, `eth_getBalance`, `eth_getCode`, `eth_getStorageAt`, `eth_getProof`, `eth_getTransactionCount`, `eth_getLogs`, `eth_call`, `eth_estimateGas`, `eth_gasPrice`, `eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas`, `eth_feeHistory`, `net_version`, `web3_clientVersion`. Every network except zone-prover also accepts `eth_sendRawTransaction`, `eth_sendRawTransactionSync`, `eth_getRawTransactionByHash`, `eth_simulateV1`, `debug_traceTransaction`, `debug_traceCall`, `debug_traceCallMany`.

### Health

- `GET /api/health`

Returns `ok` when the service is up.

## Common Tasks

### Find an unknown input

Use:

```txt
/api/search?q={input}
```

Then route based on result type:

- `block` → `/block/{blockNumber}`
- `address` → `/address/{address}`
- `token` → `/address/{address}?tab=transfers`
- `transaction` → `/tx/{hash}` or `/receipt/{hash}`

Or open `/search?q={input}`, which redirects to the single match.

### Show an address's balance

Use:

```txt
/address/{address}?tab=holdings
```

### Show an address's recent activity

Use:

```txt
/address/{address}?tab=transactions
```

Optional filters:

```txt
/address/{address}?tab=transactions&status=success
/address/{address}?tab=transactions&period=24h
/address/{address}?tab=transactions&dir=sent
```

### Show a token's holders

Use:

```txt
/address/{tokenAddress}?tab=holders
```

### Show a token's transfers

Use:

```txt
/address/{tokenAddress}?tab=transfers
```

### Show a contract's source or ABI

Use:

```txt
/address/{contractAddress}?tab=contract
```

### Interact with a contract

Use:

```txt
/address/{contractAddress}?tab=interact
```

### Show transaction internals

Use:

```txt
/tx/{hash}?tab=overview
/tx/{hash}?tab=balances
/tx/{hash}?tab=events
/tx/{hash}?tab=trace
/tx/{hash}?tab=raw
```

### Read a receipt as data

Use:

```txt
/receipt/{hash}.json
/receipt/{hash}.txt
```

### Simulate a call before sending it

Use:

```txt
/simulate?from={address}&to={address}&data={calldata}&value={value}
```

## Current Limitations

Tempo Explorer currently does not expose top-level network analytics, a top-level transaction list, validator or staking explorer pages, a public token/address verification workflow, or historical contract source diffs.
